details: Canonical production input was corrected to Kokoro and queue/daily-control.json was revision-bumped to retrigger Episode Factory, but no new Factory workflow run or persisted episode-state/render revision has appeared after commit 3ac7a985f1c3398696f8bb5896c0d3801dac5de2. The current episode remains on the older Edge-based render/state, so independent QA cannot review the intended Kokoro narration or advance QA. This is fail-closed: do not publish. GitHub documents that events caused by GITHUB_TOKEN do not recursively create workflow runs except workflow_dispatch/repository_dispatch; the available connector does not expose a workflow-dispatch action. Next safe recovery is a real Episode Factory workflow_dispatch (or the next scheduled Factory run), then review only the newly generated Kokoro artifacts.
